newsitem.title: USA: Realtek sues seven Nomura execs for fraud.
newsitem.headline: Realtek sues seven Nomura execs for fraud.

text.p: Realtek Industries Inc, a privately-owned real estate development and investment firm, filed a lawsuit against seven Nomura Securities International Inc executives alleging systematic fraud, the plaintiff's attorney's said on Tuesday.
But lawyers representing the Nomura executives said the suit was frivolous and a repetition of a suit filed two-and-a-half years ago in Ohio, where Realtek is based.
The suit stemmed from an October 1993 agreement in which Nomura was to refinance 59 Realtek rental housing developments through a securities issue of about $165 million, the plaintiff's lawyers said.

But the complaint alleged that Nomura in fact siphoned off money in additional compensation by pricing the Realtek transaction to include undisclosed, built-in trading profits, the plaintiff's lawyers said.
